name: Quranic Stories Manifest
description: Comprehensive manifest of 122+ Quranic stories with verse mappings, Arabic content, and cross-surah connections

stories.summary_en: The creation of Adam, the test in Paradise, the descent to Earth, and the path to repentance.

segments.summary_en: Allah announces to the angels the creation of a khalifa on Earth
Adam is taught the names of all things
Angels prostrate to Adam, but Iblis refuses
Adam and wife in Paradise with one prohibition
Adam receives words of repentance and is forgiven
Detailed account of Iblis's reasoning (Al-A'raf)
The covenant with Adam (Surah Taha)
Iblis's arrogance and vow to mislead (Surah Sad)

connections.explanation_en: Surah Al-A'raf provides more detail about Iblis's dialogue

stories.summary_ar: قصة خلق آدم عليه السلام، واختباره في الجنة، ونزوله إلى الأرض، وطريقه إلى التوبة. تتناول القصة رفض إبليس السجود لآدم وعداوته الأبدية للبشر.

stories.summary_en: Prophet Nuh's 950 years of calling his people to monotheism, the building of the Ark, and the Great Flood.

segments.summary_en: Nuh's methods of calling his people day and night
Building the Ark and the mockery of his people
The flood and loading the Ark
Nuh's son refuses to board and drowns
The Ark settles on Mount Judi
Nuh calls upon his Lord after rejection

connections.explanation_en: After years of rejection, Allah commands building the Ark

stories.summary_ar: قصة نوح عليه السلام ودعوته لقومه تسعمائة وخمسين عاماً، وبناء السفينة، والطوفان العظيم الذي أهلك المكذبين ونجا منه المؤمنون.

stories.summary_en: The father of prophets - his journey from idol-worshipping society to becoming Khalilullah (Friend of Allah).

segments.summary_en: Ibrahim's logical journey from stars to the Creator
Ibrahim's gentle call to his father Azar
Breaking the idols and being thrown into fire
Allah commands the fire to be cool and safe
Angels bring news of Ishaq and the destruction of Lut's people
The ultimate test - willingness to sacrifice his son
Ibrahim and Ismail raise the foundations of the Ka'bah
Ibrahim is commanded to call people to Hajj

connections.explanation_en: After the sacrifice test, Ibrahim settles Ismail near the Ka'bah

stories.summary_ar: قصة أبي الأنبياء إبراهيم عليه السلام، رحلته من عبادة الأصنام إلى التوحيد، ومحاولة قومه إحراقه، وابتلاؤه بذبح ابنه، وبناء الكعبة المشرفة.

stories.summary_en: The most mentioned prophet in the Quran - from birth to liberation of Bani Israel.

segments.summary_en: Musa's mother places him in the river; found by Firawn's family
Youth, the accidental killing, and flight to Madyan
The sacred valley and receiving the mission
Confrontation with Firawn and the nine signs
Magicians recognize truth and accept faith
Parting of the sea and drowning of Firawn
Receiving the Tablets at Mount Sinai
The golden calf incident
Musa's journey with Al-Khidr

connections.explanation_en: After crossing, Bani Israel travel to Sinai

stories.summary_ar: قصة موسى عليه السلام الأكثر ذكراً في القرآن، من ولادته ونجاته من فرعون، إلى بعثته وتحريره لبني إسرائيل، ومعجزاته العظيمة.

stories.summary_en: 'The best of stories' - from the childhood dream to family reunion in Egypt.

segments.summary_en: Yusuf's dream of eleven stars
Brothers throw Yusuf in the well
Sold to the Aziz of Egypt
The temptation and Yusuf's steadfastness
Prison and interpreting dreams
Interprets king's dream, becomes minister
Brothers come to Egypt
Yusuf reveals himself, forgives brothers
Family reunited, dream fulfilled

stories.summary_ar: أحسن القصص - رحلة يوسف عليه السلام من رؤيا الطفولة إلى لقاء العائلة في مصر، عبر الجب والعبودية والسجن حتى أصبح عزيز مصر.

stories.summary_en: The miraculous birth, mission, miracles, and ascension of Prophet Isa.

segments.summary_en: Angel announces Isa to Maryam (Al-Imran)
Detailed birth narrative (Surah Maryam)
Baby Isa speaks from the cradle
Allah reminds Isa of his miracles
Disciples request table from heaven
Clarification that Isa was not crucified
Isa affirms he only taught monotheism

connections.explanation_en: Two detailed accounts of Isa's miraculous birth

stories.summary_ar: قصة عيسى عليه السلام، الولادة المعجزة، ورسالته إلى بني إسرائيل، ومعجزاته بإذن الله، ورفعه إلى السماء.

stories.summary_en: The only woman named in the Quran - her devotion, the miraculous birth, and her faith.

segments.summary_en: Maryam's mother dedicates her to Allah's service
Zakariyya's care and the miraculous provision
Angels announce Maryam is chosen above all women
Angel Jibreel appears to announce Isa
Maryam gives birth alone under a palm tree
Maryam returns with baby; Isa speaks

stories.summary_ar: قصة مريم العذراء عليها السلام، المرأة الوحيدة المسماة في القرآن، عبادتها وتكريمها وولادتها لعيسى.

stories.name_en: Story of Prophets Zakariyya and Yahya
stories.summary_en: The elderly Zakariyya is granted a son, Yahya, after years of prayer.

segments.summary_en: Zakariyya's secret prayer for an heir
Allah answers with the name Yahya
Yahya's qualities and blessings
Zakariyya prays after seeing Maryam's provision

connections.explanation_en: Two accounts of Zakariyya's prayer for a child

stories.summary_ar: قصة زكريا ويحيى عليهما السلام، دعاء زكريا للولد في الكبر، واستجابة الله له بيحيى الذي لم يجعل له سمياً.

stories.summary_en: The prophet-king who commanded jinn, wind, and understood animals.

segments.summary_en: Sulayman's kingdom over jinn, men, and birds
The ant warning its colony about Sulayman's army
The hoopoe brings news of Queen of Sheba
The Queen of Sheba visits and accepts Islam
Sulayman's death and the jinn's ignorance of unseen
The test of the throne

stories.summary_ar: قصة سليمان عليه السلام الذي سخر له الله الجن والريح والطير، ولقاؤه مع ملكة سبأ، وحكمته وملكه العظيم.

stories.summary_en: The shepherd who defeated Goliath and became a prophet-king with the Zabur.

segments.summary_en: Dawud kills Jalut in battle
Allah gives Dawud kingship and wisdom
Mountains and birds praise with Dawud
Iron made soft for Dawud
Two disputants test Dawud's judgment

stories.summary_ar: قصة داوود عليه السلام، الراعي الذي قتل جالوت وأصبح نبياً ملكاً، آتاه الله الزبور وعلمه صنعة الدروع.

stories.summary_en: The prophet of patience who lost everything but never lost faith.

segments.summary_en: Ayyub calls to his Lord in affliction
Allah heals Ayyub and restores his family
Ayyub praised for his patience

stories.summary_ar: قصة أيوب عليه السلام نبي الصبر، ابتلاء طويل بالمرض وفقدان الأهل والمال، ثم الشفاء والعافية بعد الدعاء.

stories.summary_en: The prophet who was swallowed by a whale and whose people uniquely repented.

segments.summary_en: Yunus leaves his people and boards a ship
Whale swallows Yunus; he glorifies Allah
Yunus's famous prayer in the darkness
Yunus is rescued and recovers
His people uniquely repent and are saved

stories.summary_ar: قصة يونس عليه السلام الذي التقمه الحوت ودعا ربه في الظلمات، وقومه الذين آمنوا فكشف عنهم العذاب.

stories.summary_en: Prophet Lut's struggle against the immoral people of Sodom.

segments.summary_en: Lut warns his people about their immorality
Angels visit Lut; he fears for them
Cities destroyed at dawn; stones of baked clay
Lut's wife stays behind and perishes

stories.summary_ar: قصة لوط عليه السلام ونهيه لقومه عن الفاحشة، وهلاك المكذبين بالحجارة من سجيل منضود.

stories.summary_en: The prophet who called for honesty in trade and weights.

segments.summary_en: Shu'ayb calls to worship Allah and fair dealing
Shu'ayb warns of previous nations' fate
People reject; destroyed by the Shade
Earthquake destroys the rejecters

stories.summary_ar: قصة شعيب عليه السلام نبي أهل مدين، دعوته إلى التوحيد وإيفاء المكيال والميزان، وهلاك قومه بالصيحة.

stories.summary_en: Prophet Salih and the miraculous she-camel given as a sign to Thamud.

segments.summary_en: Salih calls Thamud to worship Allah
The she-camel as a sign - don't harm her
They hamstring the camel despite warning
A single blast destroys Thamud

stories.summary_ar: قصة صالح عليه السلام وقومه ثمود، والناقة المعجزة التي عقروها فأخذتهم الصيحة.

stories.summary_en: Prophet Hud's call to the powerful people of 'Ad who were destroyed by wind.

segments.summary_en: Hud calls 'Ad to worship Allah alone
'Ad reject Hud; boast of their strength
Furious wind destroys them for seven nights
Hud and believers saved from punishment

stories.summary_ar: قصة هود عليه السلام وقومه عاد الذين كانوا أشداء أقوياء، فأهلكهم الله بريح صرصر عاتية.

stories.name_en: Story of the People of the Cave
stories.summary_en: Young believers who fled persecution and slept for centuries.

segments.summary_en: Introduction to their miraculous story
Young men who believed in their Lord
Their miraculous sleep in the cave
They awaken after centuries
Guidance about not speculating on their number

stories.summary_ar: قصة فتية الكهف الذين آمنوا بربهم فزادهم هدى، وناموا في الكهف ثلاثمائة سنين وازدادوا تسعاً.

stories.summary_en: The righteous king who traveled east and west and built a barrier against Yajuj and Majuj.

segments.summary_en: Allah established him on earth
Journey to the setting of the sun
Journey to the rising of the sun
Building the barrier against Yajuj and Majuj
Acknowledges the barrier is from Allah's mercy

stories.summary_ar: قصة ذي القرنين الملك الصالح الذي مكنه الله في الأرض، ورحلاته شرقاً وغرباً، وبناؤه السد على يأجوج ومأجوج.

stories.summary_en: Luqman's wise counsel to his son on faith, prayer, and character.

segments.summary_en: Luqman given wisdom and gratitude
Warning son against associating partners with Allah
Kindness to parents but not in disobeying Allah
Even a mustard seed's weight is accounted for
Prayer, patience, humility in walking and speaking

stories.summary_ar: قصة لقمان الحكيم ووصاياه لابنه في التوحيد والصلاة والصبر والتواضع.

stories.summary_en: The wealthy man from Bani Israel who was arrogant about his wealth and swallowed by the earth.

segments.summary_en: Qarun's immense wealth - keys needed carriers
His people advise him to seek the Hereafter
Qarun claims wealth came from his knowledge
Qarun displays wealth; people wish for the same
Earth swallows Qarun and his dwelling

stories.summary_ar: قصة قارون من قوم موسى الذي آتاه الله الكنوز العظيمة فبغى وتكبر، فخسف الله به وبداره الأرض.

stories.name_en: Story of the Two Sons of Adam
stories.summary_en: The first murder in human history - Cain killing Abel out of jealousy.

segments.summary_en: Two sons offer sacrifices; one accepted, one rejected
Qabil threatens to kill Habil
Habil's noble response - will not raise hand
Qabil kills Habil and becomes remorseful
A crow teaches Qabil how to bury his brother

stories.summary_ar: قصة ابني آدم هابيل وقابيل، أول جريمة قتل في تاريخ البشرية بدافع الحسد.

stories.name_en: Story of the People of the Elephant
stories.summary_en: Abraha's army with elephants destroyed while attempting to demolish the Ka'bah.

segments.summary_en: Allah destroys the army with birds of Ababil carrying stones

stories.summary_ar: قصة أصحاب الفيل الذين أرادوا هدم الكعبة فأرسل الله عليهم طيراً أبابيل ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل.

stories.summary_en: Bani Israel commanded to slaughter a cow to reveal a murderer, but keep questioning specifications.

segments.summary_en: Musa commands them to slaughter a cow
They keep asking for specifications
They finally slaughter but almost did not
Dead man struck with part of cow; reveals murderer

stories.summary_ar: قصة البقرة التي أمر الله بني إسرائيل بذبحها لمعرفة القاتل، وكثرة أسئلتهم وتعنتهم.

stories.summary_en: The man who passed by a ruined village, died for 100 years, then was resurrected.

segments.summary_en: Passes by ruins, wonders how Allah will resurrect
Dies 100 years, thinks it was a day
Food fresh, donkey bones reassemble - a sign

stories.summary_ar: قصة الذي مر على قرية خاوية فأماته الله مئة عام ثم بعثه ليريه قدرته على الإحياء.

stories.summary_en: A village that tried to trick Allah by fishing on Sabbath through nets, transformed into apes.

segments.summary_en: Fish came on Sabbath, not on other days
They transgressed by setting traps
Those who warned, those who stayed silent, those who transgressed
Transgressors transformed into despised apes

أمر الله الملائكة بالسجود لآدم فسجدوا جميعاً إلا إبليس أبى واستكبر وكان من الكافرين. تبين القصة طاعة الملائكة المطلقة ورفض إبليس.
stories.summary_en: Allah commanded the angels to prostrate to Adam. They all prostrated except Iblis who refused out of arrogance.

segments.summary_en: Allah commands angels to prostrate
Angels prostrate, Iblis refuses

segments.summary_ar: حوار إبليس مع الله وسبب رفضه
segments.summary_en: Iblis's reasoning for refusing

stories.summary_en: A group of jinn listened to the Quran and believed, then returned to warn their people.

segments.summary_en: Jinn listen to the Quran
Jinn believe and warn their people

stories.summary_ar: قصة يأجوج ومأجوج القوم المفسدين الذين بنى ذو القرنين السد لحجزهم، وسيخرجون في آخر الزمان.
stories.summary_en: The story of Gog and Magog, the corrupting people whom Dhul-Qarnayn blocked with a barrier.

segments.summary_en: Building the barrier against them
Their emergence at the end of times

stories.summary_ar: مثل رجل أعطاه الله جنتين فتكبر ونسي شكر الله، فأهلك الله جنتيه. مثل للمتكبرين بالنعم.

segments.summary_en: Description of the two gardens
The owner's arrogance
The believer's advice

stories.summary_ar: مثل الكلمة الطيبة كشجرة طيبة أصلها ثابت وفرعها في السماء تؤتي أكلها كل حين. مثل للإيمان والتوحيد.

segments.summary_en: Parable of good and bad word

stories.summary_ar: مثل يضربه الله لبيان ضعف الأصنام: لن يستطيعوا خلق ذبابة ولو اجتمعوا، وإن يسلبهم الذباب شيئاً لا يستنقذوه منه.

segments.summary_en: The fly parable and idols' weakness

segments.summary_en: The spider parable

stories.summary_en: The people of Tubba mentioned among destroyed nations as a warning to those who reject truth.

segments.summary_en: Tubba mentioned with destroyed nations
Mentioned in Surah Qaf

stories.summary_ar: أصحاب الرس من الأمم المهلكة، يُذكرون في سياق التحذير من التكذيب.
stories.summary_en: The people of Ar-Rass, mentioned among destroyed nations as a warning.

segments.summary_en: Mention of the people of Ar-Rass
Listed with destroyed nations

stories.summary_en: The people of the Thicket, another community to whom Shu'ayb was sent, destroyed by the torment of the Day of Shadow.

segments.summary_en: Rejection of Shu'ayb by Al-Ayka
Punishment of the Day of Shadow

stories.summary_ar: قصة طالوت الملك الذي اختاره الله لبني إسرائيل، واختباره لجنوده بالنهر، وقتل داوود لجالوت.
stories.summary_en: The story of Talut chosen as king, his army's test at the river, and Dawud killing Goliath.

segments.summary_en: Talut chosen as king
Testing soldiers at the river
Dawud kills Goliath

stories.summary_ar: حادثة الإفك عندما اتهم المنافقون أم المؤمنين عائشة رضي الله عنها، فبرأها الله من فوق سبع سماوات.
stories.summary_en: The incident of slander against Aisha, and Allah's revelation clearing her innocence.

segments.summary_en: The accusation and revealed verses
Clearing of Aisha's innocence

stories.summary_en: Prophet Idris, known for his truthfulness and patience, was raised to a high station by Allah.
stories.summary_ar: النبي إدريس عليه السلام، عُرف بصدقه وصبره، ورفعه الله مكاناً علياً.

segments.summary_en: Idris praised as truthful prophet raised to high station
Idris mentioned among the patient ones

stories.summary_en: Prophet Ismail's sacrifice, his role in building the Ka'bah with Ibrahim, and his status as a messenger.
stories.summary_ar: قصة الذبيح إسماعيل عليه السلام وبناء الكعبة مع أبيه إبراهيم ومكانته كرسول.

segments.summary_en: Ibrahim's vision and Ismail's willingness to be sacrificed
Ibrahim and Ismail raise the foundations of the Ka'bah
Ismail praised as true to his promise and a messenger-prophet

stories.summary_en: Dhul-Kifl is mentioned among the patient and righteous prophets.
stories.summary_ar: ذو الكفل عليه السلام ذُكر في الصابرين والأخيار.

segments.summary_en: Dhul-Kifl mentioned with Ismail and Idris among the patient
Dhul-Kifl mentioned among the best

stories.summary_en: Prophet Ilyas called his people to worship Allah alone and abandon the idol Ba'l.
stories.summary_ar: النبي إلياس عليه السلام دعا قومه لعبادة الله وحده وترك عبادة بعل.

segments.summary_en: Ilyas warns his people against worshipping Ba'l

stories.summary_en: Al-Yasa is mentioned among those preferred over all creation.
stories.summary_ar: اليسع عليه السلام ذُكر في المفضّلين على العالمين.

segments.summary_en: Al-Yasa mentioned among the righteous
Al-Yasa mentioned among the best

stories.name_ar: قصة النبي محمد ﷺ في القرآن
stories.name_en: Story of Prophet Muhammad in the Quran
stories.summary_en: Key Quranic passages addressing Prophet Muhammad directly, his mission, and his character.
stories.summary_ar: الآيات القرآنية الرئيسية التي تخاطب النبي محمد ﷺ مباشرة، ورسالته وأخلاقه.

segments.summary_en: You are upon great moral character
We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds
Allah consoles and reassures His Prophet
Allah expanded the Prophet's chest and eased his burden
The clear conquest and forgiveness granted

stories.name_en: Story of the People of the Garden
stories.summary_en: The owners of a garden who planned to harvest without sharing with the poor were punished when their garden was destroyed overnight.
stories.summary_ar: أصحاب الجنة الذين أقسموا ليصرمنّها مصبحين ولا يستثنون فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون.

segments.summary_en: They swore to harvest early without giving charity
The garden destroyed and they repent

stories.name_en: Story of the People of the Ditch
stories.summary_en: Believers were burned in trenches of fire by a tyrannical king for refusing to abandon their faith.
stories.summary_ar: المؤمنون الذين أُحرقوا في الأخاديد بسبب إيمانهم بالله.

segments.summary_en: The fire-filled trenches and the witnesses

stories.name_en: Parable of the Donkey Carrying Books
stories.summary_en: Those who were entrusted with the Torah but did not act upon it are likened to a donkey carrying books.
stories.summary_ar: مثل الذين حُمّلوا التوراة ثم لم يحملوها كمثل الحمار يحمل أسفاراً.

stories.name_ar: مثل الذي آتيناه آياتنا فانسلخ منها
stories.name_en: Parable of the Man Who Was Given Signs
stories.summary_en: A man given divine signs abandoned them and followed his desires, likened to a panting dog.
stories.summary_ar: مثل من آتاه الله آياته فانسلخ منها واتبع هواه كمثل الكلب إن تحمل عليه يلهث أو تتركه يلهث.

segments.summary_en: The one who abandoned Allah's signs compared to a panting dog

stories.name_en: Story of the Ant and the Hoopoe with Sulayman
stories.summary_en: The ant warns her colony of Sulayman's army, and the hoopoe brings news of the Queen of Sheba.
stories.summary_ar: النملة تحذر قومها من جيش سليمان، والهدهد يأتي بنبأ ملكة سبأ.

segments.summary_en: The ant warns her colony and Sulayman smiles
The hoopoe reports about the Queen of Sheba and her sun worship

stories.summary_en: The Queen of Sheba's encounter with Prophet Sulayman, her test, and her acceptance of faith.
stories.summary_ar: قصة ملكة سبأ مع النبي سليمان، واختبارها، وإسلامها.

segments.summary_en: She sends a gift to test Sulayman
Her throne is brought and she is tested
She submits to Allah with Sulayman

stories.name_en: Parable of the Blind and the Seeing
stories.summary_en: The blind and the seeing are not equal, nor are darkness and light — a parable for faith and disbelief.
stories.summary_ar: مثل الأعمى والبصير والظلمات والنور في التفريق بين الإيمان والكفر.

segments.summary_en: Not equal are the blind and the seeing, darkness and light, shade and heat

stories.summary_en: Allah's light is compared to a niche with a lamp, illuminated by blessed olive oil.
stories.summary_ar: مثل نور الله كمشكاة فيها مصباح، المصباح في زجاجة، الزجاجة كأنها كوكب دري.

segments.summary_en: The parable of Allah's light — niche, lamp, glass, blessed tree

stories.summary_en: Worldly life is like rain that nourishes vegetation, which then withers — a warning against attachment to this world.
stories.summary_ar: مثل الحياة الدنيا كماء أنزلناه من السماء فاختلط به نبات الأرض ثم أصبح هشيماً.

segments.summary_en: Worldly life likened to rain and vegetation that withers
Wealth and children are adornment, but good deeds are better

stories.summary_en: Spending in Allah's cause is like a grain that sprouts seven ears with a hundred grains each.
stories.summary_ar: مثل الذين ينفقون أموالهم في سبيل الله كمثل حبة أنبتت سبع سنابل في كل سنبلة مائة حبة.

segments.summary_en: Charity multiplied like a grain producing 700 grains
Charity nullified by show-off, like rain washing away soil on a rock

stories.summary_en: Haman, Pharaoh's chief minister, ordered to build a tower to the heavens in defiance of Musa's message.
stories.summary_ar: هامان وزير فرعون الذي أمره فرعون ببناء صرح ليطلع إلى إله موسى.

segments.summary_en: Pharaoh orders Haman to build a tower
Pharaoh orders Haman to build a lofty tower in Ghafir
Haman destroyed with Pharaoh and Qarun

stories.name_en: Story of the Man Who Passed by a Ruined Town
stories.summary_en: A man passes by a ruined village and wonders how Allah can bring it back, then dies for 100 years and is resurrected.
stories.summary_ar: قصة الذي مر على قرية خاوية فأماته الله مئة عام ثم بعثه.

segments.summary_en: Man dies for 100 years then resurrected as a sign

stories.summary_en: Ibrahim asks to see how Allah raises the dead, and is told to cut four birds and call them back.
stories.summary_ar: إبراهيم يسأل الله كيف يحيي الموتى فيأمره بذبح أربعة طيور وتفريقها ثم دعائها.

segments.summary_en: Ibrahim cuts four birds and they return alive

stories.name_en: The Night Journey and Ascension (Isra and Mi'raj)
stories.summary_en: The Prophet's miraculous night journey from Makkah to Jerusalem and ascension through the heavens.
stories.summary_ar: رحلة النبي ﷺ الليلية من المسجد الحرام إلى المسجد الأقصى والعروج إلى السماوات.

segments.summary_en: Glory to the One who took His servant by night from al-Masjid al-Haram to al-Masjid al-Aqsa
The Prophet sees Jibril in his true form and ascends to the Lote Tree

stories.summary_en: The Prophet's migration from Makkah to Madinah, referenced in the Quran as a pivotal moment.
stories.summary_ar: هجرة النبي ﷺ من مكة إلى المدينة كما أشار إليها القرآن.

segments.summary_en: The two in the cave — 'Do not grieve, Allah is with us'

stories.summary_en: The first major battle of Islam where 313 believers defeated a much larger army with divine assistance.
stories.summary_ar: أول معركة كبرى في الإسلام حيث نصر الله المسلمين وهم قلة على جيش أكبر بكثير.

segments.summary_en: Allah promises aid and sends angels
A thousand angels sent to aid the believers
Remember when you were few and Allah aided you at Badr

stories.summary_en: The battle where initial victory turned to difficulty when archers left their posts, with deep lessons about obedience.
stories.summary_ar: المعركة التي تحول فيها النصر الأولي إلى ابتلاء عندما ترك الرماة مواقعهم.

segments.summary_en: The Prophet positioning troops at Uhud
Lessons from Uhud — wounds alternate between nations, martyrs honored
Archers' disobedience and its consequences

stories.summary_en: The treaty that seemed like a setback was declared a manifest victory by Allah in Surah Al-Fath.
stories.summary_ar: الصلح الذي بدا كخسارة لكن الله سمّاه فتحاً مبيناً في سورة الفتح.

segments.summary_en: Indeed We have given you a manifest victory
The pledge under the tree — Allah was pleased

stories.summary_en: The triumphant return to Makkah and the fulfillment of Allah's promise.
stories.summary_ar: العودة المظفرة إلى مكة وتحقق وعد الله.

segments.summary_en: When the victory of Allah comes and people enter Islam in multitudes

stories.summary_en: The command to change the direction of prayer from Jerusalem to the Ka'bah in Makkah.
stories.summary_ar: الأمر بتحويل اتجاه الصلاة من بيت المقدس إلى الكعبة المشرفة.

segments.summary_en: The foolish will ask what turned them from their qiblah
Turn your face toward al-Masjid al-Haram

stories.summary_en: The difficult expedition that exposed the hypocrites and tested the believers' resolve.
stories.summary_ar: الغزوة الصعبة التي كشفت المنافقين واختبرت عزيمة المؤمنين.

segments.summary_en: Hypocrites make excuses to stay behind
The three companions who stayed behind and were forgiven

stories.summary_en: The Christian delegation from Najran and the call to mutual imprecation (mubahala).
stories.summary_ar: وفد نصارى نجران والدعوة إلى المباهلة.

segments.summary_en: Isa is like Adam — created from dust — and the challenge of mubahala

stories.summary_en: The Quran predicted the Romans would win after their defeat, which came true within the foretold period.
stories.summary_ar: القرآن تنبأ بانتصار الروم بعد هزيمتهم، وتحقق ذلك في المدة المحددة.

segments.summary_en: The Romans have been defeated but will be victorious within a few years

stories.summary_en: Pharaoh's civilization, its grandeur and ultimate destruction, and the preservation of Pharaoh's body as a sign.
stories.summary_ar: حضارة فرعون وعظمتها وهلاكها وحفظ جسد فرعون آية للناس.

segments.summary_en: Pharaoh's body preserved as a sign for those who come after
The plagues sent upon Egypt: flood, locusts, lice, frogs, blood

stories.summary_en: The people of Madyan who cheated in weights and measures, warned by Prophet Shu'ayb.
stories.summary_ar: أهل مدين الذين كانوا يبخسون المكيال والميزان، وأنذرهم شعيب عليه السلام.

segments.summary_en: Shu'ayb warns Madyan against cheating in weights
The earthquake seizes them

stories.summary_en: The nation of Thamud who defied Prophet Salih by killing the she-camel, a miraculous sign from Allah.
stories.summary_ar: قوم ثمود الذين عقروا الناقة التي كانت آية من الله فأهلكهم.

segments.summary_en: The she-camel sent as a sign and their defiance
The mighty blast destroys Thamud
Thamud denied and hamstrung the she-camel

stories.summary_en: Quranic references to the major signs that precede the Day of Judgment.
stories.summary_ar: الإشارات القرآنية إلى العلامات الكبرى التي تسبق يوم القيامة.

segments.summary_en: The reckoning of mankind has drawn near
The day the sky brings visible smoke
The beast that will emerge and speak to people

stories.summary_en: The trumpet will be blown twice — once to cause all to perish and once to resurrect all of creation.
stories.summary_ar: الصور يُنفخ فيه نفختان: الأولى للصعق والثانية للبعث.

segments.summary_en: The first blast causes all to fall dead, the second raises them
The trumpet blown and they rush from graves to their Lord

stories.summary_en: The scales of justice on the Day of Judgment where deeds will be weighed.
stories.summary_ar: موازين القسط يوم القيامة حيث توزن الأعمال.

segments.summary_en: The weighing on that day is truth
Heavy scales bring pleasant life, light scales bring the abyss

stories.summary_en: People on the heights between Paradise and Hell whose good and bad deeds are equal, awaiting Allah's mercy.
stories.summary_ar: أصحاب الأعراف بين الجنة والنار تساوت حسناتهم وسيئاتهم ينتظرون رحمة الله.

segments.summary_en: Men on the heights recognizing people of Paradise and Hell

stories.summary_en: Quranic descriptions of Paradise: rivers, gardens, thrones, spouses, and eternal delight.
stories.summary_ar: أوصاف الجنة في القرآن: الأنهار والجنات والأرائك والحور العين والنعيم المقيم.

segments.summary_en: Two gardens with flowing springs, fruit, and blessings
The foremost, companions of the right — their rewards
Gardens, silk, silver vessels, camphor springs

stories.summary_en: Quranic descriptions of Hell: its fire, food, drink, and torments as warnings.
stories.summary_ar: أوصاف النار في القرآن: نارها وطعامها وشرابها وعذابها تحذيراً للناس.

segments.summary_en: Companions of the left — scorching fire and boiling water
Tree of Zaqqum — food of the sinful
The Crusher — fire of Allah fueled

stories.summary_en: Allah took a covenant from the offspring of Adam, extracting them from his loins and asking: 'Am I not your Lord?'
stories.summary_ar: أخذ الله الميثاق من ذرية آدم حين أخرجهم من ظهره وأشهدهم على أنفسهم: ألست بربكم؟

segments.summary_en: When your Lord took from Adam's children their covenant

stories.summary_en: Iblis refuses to prostrate to Adam out of arrogance and is given respite until the Day of Judgment.
stories.summary_ar: إبليس يرفض السجود لآدم تكبراً ويُمهل إلى يوم القيامة.

segments.summary_en: Iblis claims superiority and is given respite
Iblis vows to mislead mankind
Iblis says he is better than Adam — created from fire vs clay

stories.summary_en: As-Samiri made the golden calf that misled the Children of Israel while Musa was on Mount Sinai.
stories.summary_ar: السامري صنع العجل الذهبي الذي أضل بني إسرائيل في غياب موسى.

segments.summary_en: Samiri makes the golden calf and Musa confronts him

stories.summary_en: Asiya believed despite being the wife of the worst tyrant, and prayed for a home in Paradise.
stories.summary_ar: آسية آمنت رغم كونها زوجة أعتى الطغاة ودعت ربها أن يبني لها بيتاً في الجنة.

segments.summary_en: Allah sets forth the example of Pharaoh's wife who prayed for salvation
She says to Pharaoh: 'A comfort for me and you, do not kill him'

stories.name_en: Story of the Mother of Musa
stories.summary_en: The mother of Musa was inspired to place her baby in a basket in the river, trusting Allah's promise.
stories.summary_ar: أُوحي إلى أم موسى أن تلقيه في اليم ووعدها الله بإرجاعه وجعله من المرسلين.

segments.summary_en: Mother inspired to cast him in the river, he is returned to her
Cast him in the chest, cast it in the river

stories.name_en: Story of the Wife of Al-Aziz (Zulaykha)
stories.summary_en: The wife of Al-Aziz attempted to seduce Yusuf, later confessed the truth and acknowledged his innocence.
stories.summary_ar: امرأة العزيز راودت يوسف ثم اعترفت بالحق وشهدت ببراءته.

segments.summary_en: She attempts to seduce Yusuf, he refuses
The women of the city and the banquet
She confesses the truth and Yusuf is cleared

stories.summary_en: A believing man from Pharaoh's family who concealed his faith defended Musa with wisdom.
stories.summary_ar: رجل مؤمن من آل فرعون يكتم إيمانه ودافع عن موسى بحكمة.

segments.summary_en: He defends Musa and warns his people
He calls his people to salvation and warns of the Hereafter

stories.summary_en: Musa travels with Al-Khidr and witnesses three seemingly unjust acts, each with hidden divine wisdom.
stories.summary_ar: موسى يسافر مع الخضر ويشهد ثلاثة أفعال تبدو ظالمة لكنها تحمل حكمة إلهية خفية.

segments.summary_en: Musa seeks the junction of the two seas and meets Khidr
Khidr damages the ship of poor fishermen
Khidr kills the boy
Khidr rebuilds a wall without pay
Khidr explains the hidden wisdom behind each act

stories.name_en: The Three Messengers and the Town
stories.summary_en: Three messengers sent to a town were rejected, and a believing man from the outskirts came to support them.
stories.summary_ar: ثلاثة رسل أُرسلوا إلى قرية فكذّبوهم وجاء رجل مؤمن من أقصا المدينة يسعى.

segments.summary_en: Two then three messengers sent and rejected
A man from the outskirts comes running to support the messengers
A single blast destroys the town

stories.summary_en: Two men — one rich and arrogant about his gardens, the other faithful — a parable about worldly attachments.
stories.summary_ar: رجلان: أحدهما غني متكبر بجنتيه والآخر مؤمن. مثل في التعلق بالدنيا.

segments.summary_en: The rich man boasts about his gardens
The believer responds and the garden is destroyed
The rich man wrings his hands in regret

stories.summary_en: The people of Saba had abundant blessings but turned away, so Allah sent the flood of the dam.
stories.summary_ar: قوم سبأ كانوا في نعمة فأعرضوا فأرسل الله عليهم سيل العرم.

segments.summary_en: Two gardens and abundant provision, then the flood of the dam
Their settlements scattered and they became tales

stories.summary_en: The mighty nation of 'Ad built tall structures and defied Prophet Hud, destroyed by a furious wind.
stories.summary_ar: قوم عاد الذين بنوا وشيّدوا وتجبروا فأهلكهم الله بريح صرصر عاتية.

segments.summary_en: Iram of the pillars, the like of which had not been created
Destroyed by a screaming violent wind for seven nights and eight days
Hud warns them at Al-Ahqaf and the cloud appears

stories.summary_en: Nuh's people rejected his 950 years of preaching and were destroyed by the great flood.
stories.summary_ar: قوم نوح الذين كذّبوه 950 سنة فأهلكهم الله بالطوفان العظيم.

segments.summary_en: Nuh describes his people's stubborn rejection
The flood — gates of heaven and springs of earth

stories.name_en: Intercession on the Day of Judgment
stories.summary_en: Intercession on the Day of Judgment — only by Allah's permission and for those He approves.
stories.summary_ar: الشفاعة يوم القيامة لا تكون إلا بإذن الله ولمن ارتضى.

segments.summary_en: Who can intercede with Him except by His permission
They cannot intercede except for those He approves

stories.name_en: Creation of the Heavens and the Earth
stories.summary_en: The creation of the heavens and earth in six periods, with signs in the natural world.
stories.summary_ar: خلق السماوات والأرض في ستة أيام والآيات في الكون.

segments.summary_en: Creation in six periods — earth in two, provisions in four, heavens in two
Are you more difficult to create or the heaven?

stories.name_en: The Village and the Fish (Sabbath Detail)
stories.summary_en: The people who tried to circumvent the Sabbath law by setting traps for fish on Friday.
stories.summary_ar: القوم الذين احتالوا على تحريم الصيد يوم السبت بنصب الشِّباك يوم الجمعة.

segments.summary_en: Fish come openly on Sabbath, they devise tricks, transformed into apes

stories.name_en: Children of Israel in the Quran
stories.summary_en: The comprehensive story of Bani Israel — their deliverance, blessings, trials, and repeated disobedience.
stories.summary_ar: قصة بني إسرائيل الشاملة: نجاتهم ونعم الله عليهم وابتلاءاتهم وعصيانهم المتكرر.

segments.summary_en: Manna and quails sent down, complaints about food
Musa strikes the rock and 12 springs gush forth
The mountain raised over them and the covenant

stories.summary_en: Ya'qub's patience through the loss of Yusuf and his beautiful trust in Allah's plan.
stories.summary_ar: صبر يعقوب عليه السلام على فقد يوسف وحسن توكله على الله.

segments.summary_en: Ya'qub's eyes turn white from grief, yet he keeps hope
Yusuf's shirt restores his father's sight

stories.summary_en: Two angels sent to Babylon as a trial, teaching magic but warning people not to disbelieve.
stories.summary_ar: ملكان أُنزلا ببابل فتنةً يعلّمان الناس السحر وينهيانهم عن الكفر.

segments.summary_en: Angels at Babylon teach magic as a test

stories.name_en: The Debate About the Number of Sleepers
stories.summary_en: People debated whether the sleepers were three, five, or seven — only Allah knows their true number.
stories.summary_ar: جدال الناس في عدد أصحاب الكهف: ثلاثة أم خمسة أم سبعة والله أعلم بعدتهم.

segments.summary_en: Debate over the number — 309 years in the cave

stories.name_en: Story of the Wife of Nuh
stories.summary_en: The wife of Nuh is cited as an example of disbelief despite being married to a prophet.
stories.summary_ar: امرأة نوح مثال على الكفر رغم كونها زوجة نبي.

segments.summary_en: She betrayed her husband; being a prophet's wife did not save her

stories.name_en: Story of the Wife of Lut
stories.summary_en: The wife of Lut betrayed him and was among those destroyed with his people.
stories.summary_ar: امرأة لوط خانته وكانت من الغابرين.

segments.summary_en: She betrayed her husband and entered the Fire

stories.name_en: Story of the Son of Nuh
stories.summary_en: Nuh's son refused to board the ark, choosing to climb a mountain instead, and was drowned.
stories.summary_ar: ابن نوح رفض ركوب السفينة وآوى إلى الجبل فكان من المغرقين.

segments.summary_en: Son refuses the ark, says he'll shelter on a mountain
Nuh asks Allah about his son; told he is not of his family

stories.summary_en: The tree of Zaqqum that grows in the bottom of Hellfire, food of the sinful.
stories.summary_ar: شجرة الزقوم التي تنبت في أصل الجحيم طعام الأثيم.

segments.summary_en: Is that better hospitality or the tree of Zaqqum?
The tree of Zaqqum — food of the sinful, like boiling oil

stories.name_en: The Dog of the People of the Cave
stories.summary_en: The faithful dog that stayed at the entrance of the cave with the sleeping youth.
stories.summary_ar: الكلب الوفي الذي بقي باسطاً ذراعيه بالوصيد مع الفتية النائمين.

segments.summary_en: Their dog stretching his forelegs at the entrance

stories.summary_en: The dramatic confrontations between Musa and Pharaoh — arguments, miracles, and Pharaoh's arrogance.
stories.summary_ar: المواجهات الحوارية بين موسى وفرعون: الحجج والمعجزات وتكبر فرعون.

segments.summary_en: Musa shows the signs; Pharaoh calls him a madman
Go to Pharaoh, he has transgressed

stories.summary_en: Pharaoh's magicians initially oppose Musa but recognize the truth and declare faith despite Pharaoh's threats.
stories.summary_ar: سحرة فرعون عارضوا موسى ثم آمنوا بالحق رغم تهديدات فرعون.

segments.summary_en: Magicians cast their ropes and staffs
Musa's staff swallows their illusions
They fall prostrate and declare belief in the Lord of Musa and Harun
Pharaoh threatens them but they refuse to recant

stories.summary_en: Musa strikes the sea, it parts into two walls, the Israelites cross safely, and Pharaoh drowns.
stories.summary_ar: موسى يضرب البحر فينفلق ويعبر بنو إسرائيل ويغرق فرعون وجنوده.

segments.summary_en: Strike the sea — it parts into two towering walls
Pharaoh drowns and his body is preserved

stories.summary_en: While Musa was on Mount Sinai, the Israelites made a golden calf and worshipped it.
stories.summary_ar: في غياب موسى على الطور صنع بنو إسرائيل عجلاً ذهبياً وعبدوه.

segments.summary_en: They took the calf after Musa left
Musa returns angry, throws the tablets
They must kill themselves as repentance

stories.summary_en: Musa asks to see Allah, the mountain crumbles, and he falls unconscious.
stories.summary_ar: موسى يسأل رؤية الله فيندكّ الجبل ويخرّ صعقاً.

segments.summary_en: Show me so I may look at You — the mountain crumbles

stories.summary_en: The jinn worked for Sulayman and only discovered his death when the staff he leaned on was eaten by termites.
stories.summary_ar: الجن سُخّروا لسليمان ولم يعلموا بموته حتى أكلت دابة الأرض منسأته.

segments.summary_en: Jinn work for Sulayman — palaces, statues, basins
Termite eats his staff, jinn realize they didn't know the unseen

stories.name_en: Dawud's Trial with the Two Litigants
stories.summary_en: Two men climb into Dawud's chamber; one claims the other took his only ewe — a test for Dawud.
stories.summary_ar: رجلان يتسوران محراب داود، أحدهما يدّعي أن الآخر أخذ نعجته الوحيدة.

segments.summary_en: Two litigants test Dawud, he repents and is forgiven

stories.summary_en: Ibrahim is thrown into a great fire for smashing the idols, but Allah makes it cool and peaceful.
stories.summary_ar: إبراهيم يُلقى في النار بعد تحطيم الأصنام فيجعلها الله برداً وسلاماً.

segments.summary_en: Ibrahim smashes the idols except the largest
They said burn him — Allah says: Be cool and safe

stories.summary_en: Ibrahim reasons through the star, moon, and sun, rejecting each as they set, to prove monotheism.
stories.summary_ar: إبراهيم يتأمل الكوكب والقمر والشمس ويرفض كلاً منها عند أفولها ليثبت التوحيد.

segments.summary_en: Star, moon, sun — each sets, he declares devotion to the Creator

stories.summary_en: Ibrahim debates with the king (Nimrod) who claims divinity, silencing him with the argument about the sun.
stories.summary_ar: إبراهيم يحاجج الملك الذي ادّعى الربوبية فيفحمه بحجة الشمس.

segments.summary_en: Ibrahim says: My Lord gives life and death — bring the sun from the west

stories.summary_en: Musa flees to Midian, waters the flocks of two women, and is hired by their father.
stories.summary_ar: موسى يفر إلى مدين ويسقي لابنتي الشيخ ويعمل عنده.

segments.summary_en: Musa waters the two women's flock
The father offers his daughter in marriage for eight years of work

stories.summary_en: Musa sees a fire, approaches it, and receives his first revelation and mission from Allah.
stories.summary_ar: موسى يرى ناراً فيقترب منها فيتلقى أول وحي ورسالته من الله.

segments.summary_en: Musa approaches the fire and Allah speaks to him
The staff becomes a snake, hand shines white

stories.summary_en: Isa's miracles: speaking in the cradle, creating birds from clay, healing the blind and lepers, raising the dead.
stories.summary_ar: معجزات عيسى: الكلام في المهد وخلق الطير من الطين وإبراء الأكمه والأبرص وإحياء الموتى.

segments.summary_en: He will speak to people in the cradle
Creates birds from clay, heals blind and lepers, raises dead
The disciples ask for a table spread from heaven

stories.summary_en: Isa was not crucified but was raised to Allah, and a likeness was put over another.
stories.summary_ar: عيسى لم يُصلب بل رفعه الله إليه وشُبّه لهم.

segments.summary_en: They did not kill him nor crucify him, but it was made to appear so
Allah raised him to Himself

stories.name_en: Birth of Maryam and Her Dedication
stories.summary_en: The wife of Imran dedicates her child to Allah's service; Zakariyya is appointed her guardian.
stories.summary_ar: امرأة عمران تنذر ما في بطنها لله وزكريا يكفلها.

segments.summary_en: Imran's wife dedicates, Zakariyya cares for her

stories.summary_en: Yusuf tells his father about his dream of eleven stars, the sun, and the moon prostrating to him.
stories.summary_ar: يوسف يخبر أباه برؤياه: أحد عشر كوكباً والشمس والقمر ساجدين له.

segments.summary_en: Yusuf sees 11 stars, sun and moon prostrating
The dream fulfilled when family prostrates

stories.summary_en: Yusuf interprets dreams in prison and calls his companions to monotheism.
stories.summary_ar: يوسف يفسّر الأحلام في السجن ويدعو رفاقه إلى التوحيد.

segments.summary_en: Yusuf calls his cellmates to worship one God
He interprets their dreams correctly
Interprets the king's dream of seven fat cows

stories.summary_en: The brothers plot against Yusuf, throw him in a well, then come to him in Egypt unknowingly.
stories.summary_ar: إخوة يوسف يتآمرون عليه ويلقونه في الجب ثم يأتون إليه في مصر دون أن يعرفوه.

segments.summary_en: Brothers plot and throw Yusuf in the well
Brothers come to Egypt seeking grain, don't recognize Yusuf
Yusuf reveals himself and forgives them

stories.summary_en: The Prophet frowned at a blind man who came seeking guidance while he was speaking to Quraysh leaders.
stories.summary_ar: النبي ﷺ عبس في وجه الأعمى الذي جاء يسأل عن الهدى بينما كان يخاطب كبراء قريش.

segments.summary_en: He frowned and turned away because the blind man came to him

stories.summary_en: Abu Lahab and his wife are condemned for their fierce opposition to the Prophet.
stories.summary_ar: أبو لهب وامرأته ملعونان لشدة عداوتهما للنبي ﷺ.

segments.summary_en: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish

stories.summary_en: Sulayman was distracted by fine horses and missed his prayer, then sacrificed them in repentance.
stories.summary_ar: سليمان شُغل بعرض الخيل عن ذكر ربه فتاب وذبحها.

segments.summary_en: He was distracted by horses until sunset, then repented

stories.summary_en: A body (jinn/demon) was placed on Sulayman's throne as a trial, then he repented and was restored.
stories.summary_ar: أُلقي على كرسي سليمان جسد فتنةً ثم تاب فرُدّ إليه ملكه.

segments.summary_en: We placed a body on his throne; he repented and was granted unparalleled kingdom

Two passages tell the same event from different angles
One passage continues the narrative from another
Passages share a common theme across stories

explanation.en: The story of Adam's sons directly follows his descent to Earth
explanation.ar: قصة ابني آدم تتبع مباشرة نزوله إلى الأرض

explanation.en: Ibrahim's descendants include both Ismail (Arab prophets) and Ishaq (Israelite prophets including Musa)
explanation.ar: من ذرية إبراهيم إسماعيل (أنبياء العرب) وإسحاق (أنبياء بني إسرائيل ومنهم موسى)

explanation.en: The cow incident occurred during Musa's time with Bani Israel
explanation.ar: حادثة البقرة وقعت في زمن موسى مع بني إسرائيل

explanation.en: Sabbath breakers were descendants of those who followed Musa
explanation.ar: أصحاب السبت من ذرية بني إسرائيل الذين اتبعوا موسى

explanation.en: Qarun was from the people of Musa and rebelled with his wealth
explanation.ar: قارون كان من قوم موسى وطغى بماله

explanation.en: Both nations were destroyed for rejecting their prophets - Nuh's by flood, 'Ad by wind
explanation.ar: كلا القومين أُهلكا لرفضهم أنبياءهم - قوم نوح بالطوفان وعاد بالريح

explanation.en: Thamud succeeded 'Ad and were similarly destroyed for disobedience
explanation.ar: ثمود خلفوا عادًا وأُهلكوا مثلهم بسبب العصيان

explanation.en: Both Thamud and Lut's people destroyed for ignoring clear warnings
explanation.ar: كلا ثمود وقوم لوط أُهلكوا لتجاهل الإنذارات الواضحة

explanation.en: Angels visited Ibrahim then went to Lut; Shu'ayb's people also destroyed
explanation.ar: الملائكة زارت إبراهيم ثم ذهبت إلى لوط؛ وقوم شعيب أُهلكوا أيضًا

explanation.en: Both prophets exemplify patience through extreme trials - Yusuf in prison, Ayyub in illness
explanation.ar: كلا النبيين يجسدان الصبر في الابتلاءات الشديدة - يوسف في السجن وأيوب في المرض

explanation.en: Both called upon Allah in distress and were answered
explanation.ar: كلاهما دعا الله في الضيق وأُجيبت دعوته

explanation.en: Sulayman inherited prophethood and kingdom from his father Dawud
explanation.ar: سليمان ورث النبوة والملك من أبيه داوود

explanation.en: Zakariyya cared for Maryam and both families received miraculous children
explanation.ar: زكريا كفل مريم وكلا العائلتين رُزقت بأطفال معجزين

explanation.en: Maryam's story leads directly to Isa's miraculous birth
explanation.ar: قصة مريم تؤدي مباشرة إلى الولادة المعجزة لعيسى

explanation.en: Both stories appear in Surah Al-Kahf teaching about time and power
explanation.ar: كلتا القصتين وردتا في سورة الكهف تعلمان عن الزمن والقوة

explanation.en: Both emphasize monotheism in advising their children
explanation.ar: كلاهما يؤكدان التوحيد في نصيحة أبنائهما

explanation.en: Ibrahim built the Ka'bah; Allah protected it from Abraha's army
explanation.ar: إبراهيم بنى الكعبة؛ الله حماها من جيش أبرهة

explanation.en: Both stories demonstrate Allah's power over life and death
explanation.ar: كلتا القصتين تُظهران قدرة الله على الإحياء والإماتة

explanation.en: Both were saved from destruction of their disbelieving communities
explanation.ar: كلاهما نجا من هلاك مجتمعاتهما الكافرة

explanation.en: Isa descended from Ibrahim through Ishaq; Muhammad through Ismail
explanation.ar: عيسى من ذرية إبراهيم عبر إسحاق؛ ومحمد عبر إسماعيل
